name: shinsotsu-persona-studio
description: 新卒採用のペルソナ設計・候補者マッチ採点・スカウトメール作成をまとめて行うデスクトップアプリ
author: 採用企画チーム

scripts.app:dev: npm run build && npm run prepare:standalone && electron .
scripts.app:dir: npm run build && npm run prepare:standalone && electron-builder --dir
scripts.app:linux: npm run build && npm run prepare:standalone && electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.app:win: npm run build && npm run prepare:standalone && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.app:mac: npm run build && npm run prepare:standalone && electron-builder --mac --publish never
